title: 977. Minimum Number of K Consecutive Bit Flips

examples.explanation: No sequence of length-2 flips can fix the last zero.
Flip starting at 0, then at 4, then at 5.

hints: Scan left to right: when position i is effectively 0, the only move that can still fix it starts at i, so flip there.
Track active flips with a running count plus a marker array (or queue) instead of flipping k cells each time.
If a zero is needed but fewer than k cells remain, the answer is -1.
